The system operates as a closed-loop intelligence architecture where enterprise services form a foundational layer that supports telemetry and resource allocation. The verification function ensures operational integrity before proceeding to distillation. The distillation flywheel processes external inputs through a hierarchical grading mechanism, aligning them with internal models. This creates a feedback loop where each iteration refines both the external evaluator and the internal policy engine. The dual nature of this system lies in its ability to maintain consistency across heterogeneous infrastructures while enabling adaptive learning. Failure modes include service outages, misaligned grading criteria, or corrupted input streams. These can be mitigated by redundant checks and error propagation protocols within the telemetry chain.
